entry.title: Getting a brand new site crawled
entry.summary: A domain registered this morning has no reputation, no inbound links, and no history. Google has no reason to visit it and no way to know it exists.…

entry.title: Indexer: a self-hosted replacement for paid indexing services
entry.summary: How I built a personal instant-indexing tool on the Google Indexing API and IndexNow: sitemap change detection, quota pooling, and an audit that finds why a page refuses to index.
